Name: Is It Cake
Author: LeFauxMatt
Description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Ulr2XSt.png[/img]
Now you can be the cake artist of your dreams. When you craft a Pink or Chocolate Cake, it will take on the appearance of whatever item you are holding.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/oszWv38.png[/img]
Is It Cake is safe to add/remove at any time. If you have any disguised cakes crafted, and you remove this mod, they will all revert to Pink or Chocolate cakes.

Feel free to visit me on my [url=https://lxnq.to/discord]Discord server[/url] for announcements and early access to beta releases of my mods.
You're also welcome to seek support or submit issues there. You can also find me on the Stardew Valley discord in #making-mods (LeFauxMatt#6785).
